title: Navigate to the home section from the top navigation
description: A visitor can return to the home section from the top navigation and see the landing page start of the site.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the home link in the top navigation
Verify the home section is displayed

title: Open the Contact section from the top navigation
description: A visitor can jump from the homepage to the Contact section and see the contact form area.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Contact link in the top navigation
Verify the Contact section is displayed

title: Open the About section from the top navigation
description: A visitor can jump from the homepage to the About section and see the correct landing-page content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the About link in the top navigation
Verify the About section is displayed

title: Validate that Name and Email are required in the contact form
description: A lead who tries to submit the contact form without Name and Email sees validation and can correct the fields before resubmitting successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the Mobile field with a valid mobile number
Fill in the Subject field with a valid subject
Fill in the Message field with a valid message
Click the Send Message button
Verify validation prompts for the missing Name and Email fields are displayed

title: Submit a complete inquiry through the contact form
description: A lead can fill out all contact fields and successfully submit an inquiry from the contact form.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the Name field with a valid name
Fill in the Email field with a valid email
Fill in the Mobile field with a valid mobile number
Fill in the Subject field with a valid subject
Fill in the Message field with a valid message
Click the Send Message button
Verify a successful submission confirmation is displayed

title: Continue browsing from the hero with Explore More
description: A visitor can use the Explore More call to action and reach additional landing page content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Explore More button
Verify additional landing page content is displayed

title: Access the Rooms dropdown menu

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Rooms dropdown in the top navigation
Verify the Rooms menu options are displayed

title: Access the Blog dropdown menu
description: A visitor can open the Blog dropdown and see its menu options.

title: Access the Pages dropdown menu

title: Move the hero carousel to the next slide
description: A visitor can use the carousel next control and see the visible hero content change to the next slide.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the next carousel control
Verify the hero carousel content changes to a different slide

title: Move the hero carousel to the previous slide
description: A visitor can use the carousel previous control and see the visible hero content change to the prior slide.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the previous carousel control
Verify the hero carousel content changes to a different slide

title: Open the pro version prompt from the navigation
description: A visitor can use the pro version call to action and see the purchase prompt.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Buy Pro Version button
Verify a pro version prompt is displayed
